name: std/net
description: Opens TCP connections and transfers bytes with explicit connection lifetimes.
readme: Opens TCP connections and transfers bytes with explicit connection lifetimes.
Import this module with use net.

files.content:
-- Opens TCP connections and transfers bytes with explicit connection lifetimes.
public define Connection as opaque.
public use "net" function connect(host of type text, port of type unsigned 64) of type fallible pointer to Connection.
public use "net" function listen(host of type text, port of type unsigned 64) of type fallible pointer to Connection.
public use "net" function accept(listener of type pointer to Connection) of type fallible pointer to Connection.
public use "net" function port(listener of type pointer to Connection) of type fallible unsigned 64.
public use "net" function send(connection of type pointer to Connection, content of type text) of type fallible unsigned 64.
public use "net" function receive(connection of type pointer to Connection, size of type unsigned 64) of type fallible text.
-- Advanced socket controls. sendSome may write fewer bytes than requested.
public use "net" function sendSome(connection pointer to Connection, content text) giving fallible unsigned 64.
public use "net" function shutdown(connection pointer to Connection, direction text) giving fallible nothing.
public use "net" function nodelay(connection pointer to Connection, enabled boolean) giving fallible nothing.
public use "net" function keepalive(connection pointer to Connection, enabled boolean) giving fallible nothing.
public use "net" function close(connection of type pointer to Connection) of type fallible nothing.
